title: Number Bubble Shooter
description: Have fun with the whole family in this colorful number puzzle game! Shoot numbered balls onto the board and merge matching ones to create bigger numbers. Use powerful rocket boosters to clear a round area and make room for more moves. Easy to learn and packed with cheerful challenges, it’s perfect for players of all ages to practice quick thinking, strategy, and have a blast together.

title: Finger Heart Monster Refill
description:
Do you love Finger Heart posing? Do you want to make Finger Heart with a cute character? Let's Play This Game. In Finger Heart: Monster Refill, you must choose how to fit your finger with other
adorable monsters to form a perfect heart. To fill a perfect heart, you don’t need any special skills, just use your imagination and creativity.  They can change its shape in many ways. You'll need to think carefully about which form fits the shape of your fingers. Come make hearts with cute monsters!

title: Color Sort Puzzle
description: Spend your time wisely, relaxing and training your mind all at once! Put the water in the most strategic flask and enjoy when everything falls into place.

title: Battle Arena
description: Battle Arena is a thrilling RPG adventure battle game that seamlessly blends heart-pounding action with strategic gameplay. Create your team from over 50 unique heroes, each inspired by iconic characters you know and love.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Stick Hero Fight
description: Enter the most nervous stickman battles. In Stick Hero Fight, you as a mighty stickman hero. Fight through waves of enemies using incredible battle skills. This action game lets you upgrade your hero and unleash devastating attacks to dominate every fight! Use punches, weapons, and powerful skills to deliver deadly attacks.

title: My Dreamy Flora Fashion Look
description: Welcome to My Dreamy Flora Fashion Look. Girls! You know that spring is on its way when you see the trees starting to bud and bloom, and the bulbs you planted last fall start to sprout out of the ground. Join with Ellie and their friends to celebrate the most beautiful and colorful season.

title: Lovie Chics Spring Break Fashion
description: Lovie Chics Spring Break Fashion” is your ultimate destination for chic and trendy outfits perfect for the spring break season! Explore our curated collection of vibrant dresses, stylish swimwear, and must-have accessories designed to elevate your style and make a statement wherever you go. Whether you’re hitting the beach, lounging by the pool, or exploring new destinations, we have everything you need to look and feel fabulous all spring break long.

title: Rope Sorting
description:
In the game “Rope Sorting” you are waiting for exciting puzzles, where you need to sort the ropes. Pass an infinite number of levels, collect stars, use aids, be the first!

Rollback actions - allows you to return to the previous step to take a different path.

Adding a coil - makes it easier to pass a level by adding another empty coil.

title: REDLINE: Idle Front
description: REDLINE: Idle Front is a sleek idle-clicker hybrid where you build and upgrade five high-tech turrets to crush endless waves of enemies. Strategically deploy machine guns, shotguns, snipers, missile launchers, and lasers to handle bosses every five waves.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Bullet Heroes
description:
Join the ultimate team-based shooting game! Team up with players worldwide to strategize, outsmart, and dominate your enemies. Experience intense firefights on stunning high-definition 3D maps, with multiple game modes and a vast arsenal of weapons. Become an elite agent, master your skills, and lead your team to victory.
Dive into the action and enjoy the thrill of cooperative gameplay. 
Are you ready to become a hero?

title: My Perfect Mine
description:
Become the leader of the Mining Empire!
You are the head of the mining business. There are several workers under your leadership. Send them to the mine to extract a valuable resource - gold. But not everything is as monotonous as you might think!

title: Gate Heroes Battle
description: Embark on a journey with your cute monsters and go through positive gates to build up your strength. This will help you defeat stronger enemies. Also watch out for traps and obstacles in your way. Try to reach your strongest form to defeat the final boss.

title: Soul Not Found
description: Soul Not Found is an idle-incremental game with an undead army and battle theme.  Story The necromancer who has just lost the great war is ready to rebuild his armies and fight his way back to the top.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Fury Tanks
description: Beyond the hills and forests, war waits in silence. When it starts, it’s you, your tank and the enemy in your sights. Build your armor, power up your cannon and let instinct guide your aim. When the ground shakes, make sure it’s because you fired first.

title: ThumbPinball
description: ThumbPinball is an engaging physics-based pinball game that challenges players to manipulate various mechanisms and angles to achieve their objectives. Bounce the ball strategically to hit specific targets and tackle formidable bosses across exciting levels. Ideal for quick play sessions, it offers a blend of skill, strategy, and fun for all ages.

title: Panda Kitchen Idle Tycoon
description: Want to become the best restaurant tycoon? You’ll build your own panda-themed food empire in Panda Kitchen: Idle Tycoon. Earn idle profits, and manage your way to success. Unlock new dining tables and kitchen equipment to improve efficiency. Recruiting chefs and servers to create an ultra-efficient restaurant team.

title: Samurai vs Yakuza - Beat Em Up
description: Yakuzas have captured hidden treasures and ruins. Take action to save the places from the yakuza using your samurai skills! Fight with yakuza in different locations. Destroy the yakuza using the swords and weapons found in the boxes. The future of the kingdom is in your hands. Prepare for the fight now and save the kingdom!

title: Best Friends Puzzle
description: Hop on an epic adventure with the Bug Heroes and help them defeat the menacing birds of the forest! Strategically link at least three symbols of the same colour to empower the Heroes with their special perks. Explore the lush green forests with your bug friends.

title: Dinosaurs vs Asteroids
description: Giant asteroids are crashing down on Earth. But the dinosaurs have a plan! They have special mounts on their backs where you can attach a variety of weapons: from miniguns and flamethrowers to alien shotguns and blasters. Additionally, there are special species of dinosaurs that can shoot powerful spikes or break asteroids with their claws.

title: Bouncing Chick
description: In Bouncing Chick you have to reach your nest as fast as you can, avoiding obstacles and hazards. Go to the top of the level and try to beat your record! There are 24 levels to beat, so what are you waiting for? Start your climbing to the top!

title: Wave Road 3D
description: Wave Road 3D is a fast-paced reflex game that challenges your focus, timing, and precision. You control a sleek arrow gliding through a floating road filled with gears, traps, and collectible gems. Whether you’re chasing high scores in endless mode, conquering 20 handcrafted levels in classic mode, or racing head-to-head with a friend in 2 player mode, Wave Road 3D offers a refreshing and dynamic experience.

title: Super Hero Driving School
description:
Drive unique super hero vehicles and perform stunts on multiple crazy tracks.

It’s a bird! No, it’s a plane! Or maybe a car? What the hell is that thing? I want to drive this right now! 

So buckle up and prepare for super fun times in Super Hero Driving School. Because even heroes need a driving license, you know! 

Drive, and fly unique super hero vehicles and perform stunts like never before. And be careful, because super heroes can have super crashes! :D

title: Drunk But Not Wasted Knight
description: Stumble into a moonlit alley and befriend a tipsy yet oddly wise knight in this comedic medieval visual novel. Banter, make choices, and nudge affection as you chase stories, dodge trouble, and unlock quirky endings.

title: Las Vegas Poker
description: Play one of the most exciting card games in the world. Win up to 3 types of big tournaments and unlock your avatar. Rule the poker game and become King Of The Table. Collect daily rewards, customize your game mode, and live the excitement of Las Vegas Casino.

title: Hungry Snake Io
description: Hungry Snake.io is a classic game. Here you can try three game modes, Endless mode, Toilet Man, and Monster Brawl. Please note that there can be no collision between worms! In addition, our team takes user experience very seriously, we are always happy to improve the game so that every player can have a better gaming experience, if you encounter any difficulties during the game, please feel free to leave us a message!

title: Ocean Pop
description: Ocean Pop is a lively underwater puzzle game where real 2D bubbles float, bounce, and cluster with natural physics. Pop matching bubbles, trigger chain reactions, and enjoy dynamic, ever-shifting puzzles. Its colorful ocean setting, smooth mechanics, and playful movement create a relaxing yet engaging experience that’s easy to learn and satisfying to master.

title: Chess Online
description:
Options:
- Choose an opponent from 18 difficulty levels from Beginner to World Champion
- Selection of time control modes: Unlimited, Bullet, Blitz, Rapid, Classic
- Highlighting possible moves when choosing a piece
- Cancel the move, if there was a yawn, you can go back
- Interactive hints, showing the best move during the game
- Analysis after the game, highlights mistakes and gives recommendations on how to play
- Replay the game from the right place
- Setting the handicap

title: Pet Salon 2
description: Take care of the cutest puppy and cat that you can bathe, help it when it is sick and choose an outfit  and dress it up! Pet Salon 2 is very helpful for the daycare of your pet and have too much fun with this game.

title: Elixir Drop
description:
Drop magical elixirs, merge matching colors, and evolve them into powerful rainbow potions! 
A relaxing physics puzzle game inspired by merge mechanics and alchemy.
Plan your drops carefully and create the ultimate elixir.

title: Beat Music Battle
description: Step into the world of Beat Music Battle: 456 Survival, where rhythm meets creativity and fun! This casual music game is perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and party lovers alike.

title: City Builder
description: How do you become the mayor of your town? Find the right valley and build everything from scratch with your own hands. Then the residents will help you make your town even better and even share their equipment!

title: Shotting Balls
description: In this fun game, you'll have to use your skills to destroy all the black blocks you find in each level in order to advance to the next one. But that's not all: you'll also have to avoid losing the ball, because if it leaves the screen, you'll lose a life and, ultimately, the game. On the other hand, you can also collect gems, which will allow you to obtain new skins to give your ball a new look.

title: Bubble Shooter Vale
description: Bubble Shooter Vale is a fun and relaxing bubble shooting puzzle game where you match colorful bubbles and clear the board before time runs out. Use strategy, quick thinking, and precise shots to create huge combos. If the board gets filled, watch a reward ad to remove the last 3 lines of bubbles, or stop the timer and continue playing in relaxing mode.

title: Angry City Smasher
description: Angry City Smasher is a third-person RPG fighting simulation game with 3D-armed gorillas. Your goal is to defeat the enemy monster and destroy the marked number of buildings. Use the Ultimate Smash to make AOE damage and destroy more buildings with one hit. To be honest, it is necessary to defeat your opponent first because it will run to you on the level. No one wants to be disturbed by others. Good luck!

title: Is it right
description:
This puzzle game will challenge your wits and attentiveness - do it right!
Look for pumping logic, look for the right colors, go through levels, open skins!

title: FaceChart
description: Do you dream of creating wild, fabulous looks like your favorite artists on social media? Dive into the enchanting realm of Face Chart! Wondering what a face chart is? It's your chic canvas to plan the next jaw-dropping, glamorous look. Grab a piece of paper and let it be your pocket-sized playground—experiment with new colors you hesitated to wear, pick and mix diverse designs for an endless array of possibilities.

title: PopSortica
description:
PopSortica is a new chapter in Poppy’s adventures! Join the underwater SORTING voyage! Challenging yet relaxing levels await as you sort things out.
The rules are simple, but the difficulty increases with each new level.
Special obstacles and conditions will challenge your skills, while boosters will help you achieve the best results faster.
Dive deep with Mermaid Poppy and challenge yourself in this exciting sea sorting adventure!

title: Summer Spotlight Differences
description: Dive into the sunny and captivating world of Summer Spotlight Differences, a delightful spot-the-difference game that's perfect for all ages. This engaging game challenges you to find all 5 differences in each level to advance to the next, offering endless fun and a great way to sharpen your observational skills. Enjoy the challenge and have a blast with this fantastic spot-the-difference game!

title: Tankgank
description: Tankgank is a fast-paced io game where you take control of a tank and battle for dominance in a massive multiplayer arena. Navigate the battlefield, destroy opponents, and expand your territory to prove you’re the ultimate tank commander.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Digital Aqua
description:
Digital Aqua is a digital aquarium designed for PC Browser.
Explore the vibrant world of aquariums, where colorful tropical fish and stunning underwater landscapes come to life.
Transform your Monitor into a serene and enchanting aquarium that fills your living room with comfort and wonder.

title: Sand Blast
description:
Sand Blast – A Satisfying Flowing-Sand Puzzle Experience, a relaxing yet strategic puzzle game built on soft, flowing sand physics!
Every block is made of loose, unstable sand — place it, and it instantly crumbles and shifts with gravity. These pieces won’t stay still, so you’ll need to think ahead and plan every move carefully.

title: Aloha Mahjong
description: Collect all the Hawaiian items in this daily Mahjong at Home game. Try to clear all tiles by pairing the same free Aloha tiles. A tile is free if it is not covered and has at least one free side.

title: Upside Down
description:
Upside Down is a puzzle platformer game in which you must control the character, gather all of the stars and keys, and complete all of the levels.

The levels are difficult and mental exercises. In order to finish the levels, you have to switch between two distinct worlds. The lovely graphics and calming soundtrack make the game enjoyable and lovely. Go through the portal, leap, run, get away, and enjoy yourself.

title: Zombie Road
description:
In a world where the dead walk, the real challenge is getting smash them all with your car.
Even the apocalypse can’t stop the Zombie driver. Outfit your car with defenses, smash through the undead and reach the end.

title: Castle Craft
description: Embark on a mystical journey in Castle Craft, where you merge resources and unlock the secrets of time. Start in a land cloaked in fog, using ancient keys to reveal hidden territories and trace your lost family's steps across eras.

title: Panda Running
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure through the bamboo forest in Panda Running, an endless runner game where you guide a cute panda through various obstacles like traps, tree stumps, and boulders. Collect power-ups along the way to protect and boost yourself, experiencing non-stop excitement in this adrenaline-fueled journey.

title: Ninja Climb
description: Embark on a thrilling ascent in Ninja Climb, a captivating 2D game where your nimble ninja scales towering buildings. Click to seamlessly leap between structures, dodging obstacles along the way, and utilize rewarded video ads to revive when challenges arise, ensuring an adrenaline-packed ninja adventure.

title: Pixel Shoot
description: Pixel Shoot is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game. It's simple to play by just tapping the cannons. Make sure you pay attention to the color and base your strategy around it. You must also manage your capacity, and timing is key! Send your cannons in the right order, manage the flow, and maximize your score.

title: Block Puzzle - Jewel Forest
description: An addictive block puzzle game that helps train your eyes and brain. It is a combination between the Tetris and Jewels game styles.

title: Ghostly Graveyard Halloween Special
description:
This Halloween, experience the thrill of Ghostly Graveyard is a spooky platformer adventure where you explore a haunted graveyard and unravel its mysteries. Navigate challenging levels, collect coins, and avoid ghostly encounters. Can you solve the graveyard's secrets?
A Halloween Special Spooky Puzzle Adventure.

title: Sprunki Memory Card Match
description:
Put your memory to the ultimate test with Sprunki Memory Card Match! Dive into a world of fun and challenge as you flip cards to reveal and match delightful Sprunki characters, scenes, and surprises. Perfect for kids and adults alike, this game combines entertainment with brain-boosting fun!
Challenge yourself or compete with friends to see who has the sharpest memory. With Sprunki Memory Card Match, every flip is a step closer to unlocking fun surprises and reaching the top!

title: Summer Connect
description: You can test your pattern detection skills in this relaxed mahjong & connect puzzle game with summer theme. You can eliminate pair of same tiles. The line connecting the two clicked tiles can't have more than 2 corners. Some levels the tiles can auto slide( to left, to right, to up, to bottom). Can you clear the board before time runs out? Enjoying matching summer tiles with 30 puzzle stages in this game.

title: Steal Brainrot Monsters!
description:
Step into a world of fun, charm, and Italian flair with Buy Cute and Funny Animals! From the tiny and delightful Nubini Pizzanini to the rare and majestic Tralalelo Tralala and the playful Los Tralalelitos, there’s no shortage of adorable creatures to collect.

Build your very own cozy base, place your animals in it, and make them feel right at home. In return, they’ll reward you with coins, which you can use to unlock even more animals and exciting upgrades.

title: Crazy Stunts 3D
description: Get behind the wheel and conquer extreme tracks! Jump from ramps, compete with players, complete modes and unlock new cars!

title: Stickman Halloween Survive
description:
Now that Halloween is here, the gloomiest day of the year, it's time to bring back the courageous white stickman who is an expert at vanquishing monsters. Stop procrastinating and start enjoying Stickman Halloween Survive right now on your preferred mobile device. It's a fun and free online game. 
Every living thing on Earth is frightened to death when monsters emerge from their underground lairs on Halloween night.

title: Fashion Makeover Dash
description: Ready for a fun fashion adventure? In Fashion Makeover Dash, you can run through the mall, collect cute outfits, stylish accessories, and shiny coins along the way! After the dash, it’s makeover time! Dress up your character with all the fashion items you collected and create the cutest look ever. You can also use coins to decorate your room and make it extra stylish. Run, collect, dress up, and have fun in the ultimate fashion makeover game!

title: Diamond mosaic
description: Ready to create your own masterpiece from a scattering of diamonds on your screen? Come to our mosaic!  Fill images with diamond scatter!

title: Smash The Bottle
description: Bottle Smash Arcade is a fun, casual arcade smash game where you shatter bottles in wild combos—perfect for fans of cool math games and Roblox-style thrills. Master quick reflexes like in Minecraft challenge levels, or go old-school with snake game breaks. Upgrade bottle-breaking action, smash for points, crush boredom Kahoot-style in this playful, fast-paced smash-the-bottle adventure!

title: Sprunki Mini Games
description: We present you a compilation of several games with the famous characters Sprunki. The first game is the classic Sprunki game but with an expanded orchestra, that is, with 9 singers. In the second game, you are presented with 10 pictures to color. While the third is a game of finding differences where you have 20 levels with 10 differences on each level.

title: Octonauts Bubbles
description:
Help Captain Barnacles, Peso and Kwazii to rescue Dashi in a thrilling adventure where you must drive the GUP-A ship in the Octonauts underwater world and reach the Whale Shark overcoming all the obstacles that you'll find in your way.

Help Captain Barnacles complete all the levels of this amazing underwater Bubbles game

title: Click Click Clicker
description: Click Click Clicker is a single-player, idle clicker game where you earn money by clicking the button on the screen. Unlock various buttons, cursor styles, themes, and music.

title: Grill Party
description: Welcome to Grill Party! Step into the exciting world of grilling and become a master at crafting tasty skewers! In Grill Party!, you’ll experience a thrilling match-3 puzzle game where you’ll arrange meats, seafood, and veggies to create perfect combos. Serve up mouthwatering treats and show off your grilling skills!

title: Bunnyhop and Surf Maps
description: Game that brings bunnyhop and surf from "Counter Strike" straight to your browser! The game features a variety of parkour maps, many knife skins, unique bunnyhop mechanics, the ability to accelerate with a knife, and the opportunity to compete with other players to see who can reach the finish line first.

title: Cat Match 3
description: Dive into Cat Match 3, the thrilling Match-3 puzzle adventure! Match, swap, and blast through vibrant levels filled with unique obstacles, epic power-ups, and explosive combos. Journey through enchanting worlds, unlock daily rewards, and conquer special events. Challenge friends on the leaderboard or team up in exciting tournaments. With increasing difficulty and endless puzzles, every swipe brings you closer to victory. Ready to start matching magic? Join the adventure today!

title: Hit ball
description:
Hit ball is a fast-paced arcade game with roguelike elements, in which you fight off waves of enemies with ricocheting balls! With each shot you break through obstacles, knock down monsters and earn experience to improve your abilities.
Dozens of levels with unique traps, walls, boosting balls and dangerous bosses await you. Collect boosters, pick up abilities, regenerate health and strategize to survive the battle!

title: Popping Candies
description: Match and crush candies to achieve goals in this addictive puzzle game! Swap adjacent candies to form rows of three or more and clear the board. Create special candies like striped, wrapped, or color bombs to enhance your progress. Overcome obstacles like chocolate and blockers while completing each level's unique objectives. Be mindful of your limited moves! Use boosters for extra assistance and advance through challenging levels to unlock new stages.

title: Vega Mix: Fairy town
description: Join a girl named Vika and the mayor of a magical city in their quest to bring back the holiday spirit and ensure a successful New Year! Play challenging match 3 levels by connecting elements and solving puzzles to overcome various obstacles and help the mayor overcome problems.

title: Brainrot Ice Truck
description:
Step into the wild world of Brainrot Ice Cream, where over-the-top characters and ridiculous chaos blend perfectly with sweet, frozen treats!
Run your own ice cream truck, serving unhinged yet oddly charming customers with outrageous flavor combos, absurd toppings, and just the right amount of brain freeze.
Customize your setup, upgrade your gear, and keep up with the madness as each day gets weirder than the last.
Can you scoop fast enough to satisfy this wonderfully deranged crowd?

title: Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2
description: Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2 is a famous snake-hunting game when Sprunki head and Squid head as main avatar character in this game. You become a small snake that runs endlessly and continuously moves to eat the food, each time it eats it will become longer. Squid Sprunki Slither Game 2 is a simple game that became an instant success soon after its launch.

title: Air Strike 2D
description: Become a bomber pilot and fly an army airplane in epic air strikes! Drop bombs, destroy tanks, cannons and soldiers, intercept missiles and shoot down drones. Eliminate enemy troops and destroy their military bases. Upgrade your aircraft with deadly weapons and cool gear. Dominate the battlefield from the sky and defeat the villain general in a final airstrike!

title: Mindblow
description: Get ready for a mind-teasing adventure in Mindblow, the ultimate word puzzle game that challenges your vocabulary and logic skills. Explore hundreds of fun and engaging levels — from simple to truly tricky — all designed to keep your brain sharp and entertained. Play for free on desktop or mobile, uncover hidden words from beautiful images, and enjoy new levels added every month. Think you have what it takes to become a true word master?

title: Cocktailz
description: Thirsty? Make all sorts of cocktails in this refreshing Match-3 game! Excessive alcohol consumption is harmful to health, but you can play this game without moderation.

title: Ping Pong Air
description: Table tennis, also known as ping pong, is an easy and enjoyable arcade game in which you control the bat as simply as in life: with the mouse or the movement of your finger. Several modes await you to suit every taste. In classic mode, you go through worlds, earn cups and unlock new opportunities. In Halloween mode, you have to banish spirits for a while, improving your reaction. In Career mode, you move up the tournament ladder, taking part in games against increasingly stronger opponents.

title: Obby Tower Parkour Climb
description:
Dive into the parkour adventure with Obby in the Hell Tower game theme. Climb colored platforms and get to the finished platform for a great reward.
The game contains three hell tower maps easy, medium, and hard. Play these maps in two different modes normal mode and challenge mode. Try to do your best timing in challenge mode in either single-player or 2 player game mode. You can also compete against your friend in normal mode in the 2-player game mode option.

title: Sakura Branch
description:
The "Sakura Branch" is an interesting and beautiful puzzle game.

In the game you have pieces of a dry branch of a beautiful tree.
Turn them around and put them together.
If you combine all the pieces, life will return to the branch and it will delight you with beautiful flowers!
If you are new, you can play on a very small field on which there will be very little branches.
But if you feel strong enough, you can collect a whole tree on a huge field!

title: Cube to Hole Puzzle
description:
Welcome to Cube to Hole Puzzle!
Get ready for an exciting and brain-teasing experience! In Cube to Hole Puzzle, your objective is simple: fill the colored cubes into their matching colored holes. But there’s a catch—limited space on the board and only a few slots to move the cubes forward. You’ll need to plan ahead and choose the right cube to move first. Strategize carefully to avoid blocking yourself and clear the board to progress through each level!

title: Bubble Match Merge
description: A colorful bubble merge puzzle game where you pull bubbles, connect matching items, and complete level goals within a limited number of moves.

title: Hawaii Match 5
description: Escape to the paradise in Hawaii Match 5! Explore dreamlike landscapes while matching exotic fruits and flowers. With over 4000+ levels, complete challenging goals in limited moves by forming rows of five or more symbols. Unlock powerful boosters and combine symbols for explosive bonuses. Discover hidden treasures and let your soul unwind in this captivating island adventure. Play Hawaii Match 5 now and enjoy endless fun!

title: Screw Sort 3D: Screw Puzzle
description: Ready to challenge your mind and intelligence in the Screw Sort 3D: Screw Puzzle. This casual 3D Screw Puzzle game will take you into a world of creativity and puzzle solving fun. Here you need to match the screws of the same color and move them to the correct box. You sort screws by their colors. Keep moving the model to find the corresponding color.

title: Vice City Driver
description: Get ready to skid the wheels of a stunning sports car through an expansive morning city map! Customize and upgrade your sports car with cool upgradables and become the best driver in the city. Take your dog with you in 3 driving challenges and conquer the missions together. Use nitro to beat slow traffic and beat all speed, stunt and drift triggers spread across the map. Are you ready to show your driving skills? Prove yourself!

title: Shape Shift
description:
Shape Shift is a fast-paced arcade game set in colorful outer space. Pilot your spaceship through a field of moving geometric shapes and collect the correct targets to score points.

But stay sharp, the target shape or color constantly changes. One moment you must collect blue circles, the next moment it might switch to red triangles. Grab the right shapes and avoid the wrong ones as long as you can!

title: Mahjong Classic
description: Relax and challenge your mind with Mahjong Classic, a timeless tile-matching puzzle game with a beautiful, traditional aesthetic. Enjoy the calming backdrop and classic gameplay as you match identical tiles to eliminate them from the board. The goal is simple: clear all the tiles to win the game. But it’s not just about matching any tiles—only the free tiles on the edge can be selected, adding a layer of strategy and focus to your gameplay.

title: Online Cats Multiplayer Park
description: Come to run, jump, guess, and race as a cute but competitive kitty in Online Cats - Multiplayer Park. It’s a real-time multiplayer chaos arena. Here are seven modes you can choose from. In Grab A Shabby Ball, for example, you will have to compete with your opponents and try to touch the ball to get points.

title: Horror Minecraft Partytime
description: Horror Minecraft Partytime is a spooky and interesting horror survival game. This time you will enter a familiar world of blocks. In this hide-and-seek mode, you will be the pursuer, looking for every corner. Find the weirdo in disguise and catch him.

title: War Lands
description: War Lands is an ARPG-style game with roguelike gameplay. Battle your way through a series of levels picking up buffs and loot, all while decimating hordes of enemies.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Doomsday Survival Rpg Shooter
description: Doomsday Survival Rpg Shooter is a 2D side-scrolling survival RPG shooting game. Zombies occupy the whole city. You need to recruit the last survivors to fight against zombies for a living. As humans, you need weapons, ammo, food, and medicines. Send your teammates to dispatch different buildings, go to complete the tasks in this fallen town. Time is your life, get out of the safe house and find resources!

title: Blockibo: Color Blocks
description:
Blockibo: Color Blocks is a fun and thoughtful puzzle game where every move matters.
Move colorful blocks, unlock gates, overcome obstacles and use boosters to clear the board.

title: 2048 Match Balls
description: With super simple rules and addictive gameplay, this logic game offers endless fun while challenging your brain. Merge balls and level up. Each merge increases the value of the balls while also changing their color and size. Be smart and dive into a vibrant world of numbers!

title: Elite Chess
description: Enjoy classic gameplay with three chess modes, each offering varying time settings suited to your play style. Take your chess skills to the next level, climb the ranks from Bronze to Diamond, and strive to become a top chess player.

title: Rocket Fest
description: Control the rocket to collect energy or other useful props along the way, and bomb the target at the end! This is a casual stress relief game.

title: Summer Aesthetics
description: Summer Aesthetics is a dress-up game to take selfies with different summer fashion styles around the world. Release Date July 2021 Developer Summer Aesthetics was made by Gamerina.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Geometry Dash Maze Maps V2
description: Welcome to Geometry Dash Maze Maps V2. It's a test of your agility and intelligence as you guide the square through thrilling challenges. The game features six levels, each filled with tricky mazes. The cube will automatically rush forward at a fast pace, making it challenging to keep up. Your goal is to navigate through the obstacles in time. Jump over sharp spikes, leap onto platforms, and make use of the yellow boosters to soar even higher.

title: Zombies Weapon Merge 4
description: Zombies are swarming. Are you ready to fight back? Zombies 4 – Weapon Merge is an exciting shooting and strategy game where every decision matters. Match and merge weapons to create powerful guns, then aim and shoot endless waves of zombies. Combine identical weapons, upgrade your firepower, and place them smartly to survive tougher enemies.

title: Puppy Merge
description: Puppy Merge is a unique merge game where you must grab and combine identical puppies to create a new and bigger one. Puppies will fall automatically into the arena; what you must do is drag the puppies around and merge them into identical ones. Don't let the puppies fall outside the box, or the game will end. You can try to catch the puppy and bring it back to the arena if the puppy falls.

title: Obby Football Soccer 3D
description:
Online football / soccer and real sport — play with friends or random opponents.
Penalties and matches — score amazing goals, save shots, and become your team’s hero.
Obby challenges — train your reaction and speed while passing football obstacles.
Colorful 3D graphics and the atmosphere of a real stadium.

Go from rookie to champion. Prove that you are the best player in the world of football and sport.

title: Ammo Rush Master
description:
Get ready to run, multiply, and blast your way to victory in Ammo Rush Master!
Dodge obstacles, choose the right gates, and build the biggest Ammo army of bullets. Then, grab your blaster and unleash a storm of foam darts to smash through targets, enemies, and bosses!

title: Alien Intelligence Test
description: You've been abducted. To prove you're intelligent, aliens test you with strange puzzles and machines. Push buttons, solve challenges, survive the test.

title: Skibidi Titans Hide And Seek
description: Skibidi Titans Hide And Seek throws you into a thrilling battle between clever escape artists and relentless hunters. Choose your side, master unique character abilities, and outsmart your opponents in this exciting Fun Hide Seek Game with Skibidi Titans. Quick thinking and careful movement are the keys to victory in this exciting stealth adventure. Great for fans of role-playing adventures. One of the most entertaining free online games for competitive players.

title: Words with Prof. Wisely
description:
ind words by connecting letters. Improve your attentiveness, train your brain!

Keep in mind - some crosswords will be difficult to solve.

title: Christmas Merge
description:
The winter season has returned, and the North Pole is bustling with excitement! Get ready for festive fun with Christmas Merge!

The elves are in a frenzy, scrambling to match presents in time—merge them quickly before the frost sets in!

How many Santas can you create in one go? Play now, and let's find out!

title: Shiny Jewels
description: Conquer each level with your logic, unleash powerful boosters and claim victory! Complete missions to earn unique rewards or join special events: break the chest, collect as many coins as possible within limited moves or race against time to complete the level.

title: Slide Block Puzzle
description: Slide Block Puzzle is an addictive puzzle game. With no timer or pressure, every move is a calming and satisfying challenge for your brain. Solve color block puzzles, arrange blocks to escape from challenging boxes, a game that provides a fun and satisfying experience.

title: Idle Bathroom Empire Tycoon
description: Ready to become the ultimate bathroom tycoon? In this exciting mix of simulation, management, and idle tycoon gameplay, you’ll start with a small restroom. Grow it into a luxurious five-star hygiene haven! Upgrade facilities, optimize services, and expand your empire to make your bathroom the most popular spot in town. Manage your front desk with care, and faster cashiering will give you more cash flow.

title: Jenny's Math Puzzle
description: Challenge your mind with Jenny’s Math Puzzle, a fun and brain-boosting online game where logic meets creativity. Arrange number tiles to solve equations, unlock new puzzles, and sharpen your math skills along the way. Play on your phone or computer — every move counts, and every solution brings you closer to becoming a true math master.

title: Dogs Spot The Differences
description: Immerse yourself in the charming world of 'Dogs: Spot the Differences,' a puzzle game featuring scenes filled with adorable companions. Challenge your observation skills, uncover subtle differences, and unlock new levels. With stunning visuals and escalating challenges, become a detective in a captivating journey of discovery and fun. Can you spot them all and become the ultimate enthusiast for your lovable companions?

title: Hex Triple Match
description: Hex Triple Match brings together puzzle challenges, strategic matching and merging experiences. This game consists of clever puzzle-solving and logical manoeuvres, making it ideal for those seeking a brain workout.  You need to consider how to place them to eliminate them faster. Each colour represents an item, giving you a great gaming experience. Beautiful graphics bring you visual enjoyment. Come and join the merging game world.

title: Color Dots Challenge
description: Dive into Color Dots Challenge, a bright and addictive puzzle game that puts your logic and strategy to the test. Connect, match, and move colorful dots to clear the board and score big! Simple to play yet hard to master, this free online game is perfect for quick breaks or long sessions on your phone or computer. Can you outsmart the colors and conquer every level?

title: 21 Cards
description: 21 Cards is a fun and addictive blackjack-style puzzle game where your goal is to reach exactly 21 points in each column. The game combines the thrill of classic card play with a cozy, home-style atmosphere. Place cards wisely, complete columns, and aim for the perfect 21!

title: Bubbly Lab
description: Bubbly Lab is a physics puzzle game where you have to catch all the adorable bubbles in the laboratory. Use a super strong vacuum cleaner to get the bubbles into the flask. Use your logic to move lab items to help you get bubbles. Solve interesting puzzles in this fun and unique game!

title: Barbee Black Friday Fashion
description: Get ready for a fashion-filled shopping day with Barbee Black Friday Fashion, the ultimate dress-up experience for style lovers! Barbee is hitting the mall for the biggest sale of the year, and she needs your expert fashion sense to shine. Explore chic winterwear, cozy sweaters, stylish boots, and dazzling accessories.

title: Cube Stories: Escape
description:
Immerse yourself in a fascinating plot and follow a brave video blogger who bravely goes into the dark embrace of an abandoned mansion. As you make your way through each carefully designed room, you'll encounter a series of cryptic puzzles and mind-bending challenges that will test your intelligence, observation, and creative thinking.
As the plot develops, you will be plunged into the darkness of the house's past and the mysterious history of its former inhabitants.

title: Super Pop Blast
description: Get ready for a new kind of brick shooter, with unique mechanics, rewarding challenges, and colorful levels. The object: Clear all the blocks using a limited number of balls. Plan your moves, use the score combo system, and try to get 3 stars!

title: Real Parkour Simulator
description: Real Parkour Simulator is an addictive 3D parkour adventure game. You play as an ambitious protagonist determined to conquer the world of parkour. Taking you on an exciting journey to new heights as you run, jump and climb in an immersive world. Will you rise to the challenge and become a parkour master?

title: Supermarket Simulator: Dream Store
description: Build and expand your shop: add shelves, displays, products, and decorations to attract more customers. Hire staff and manage their skills and motivation. Handle orders, discounts, and marketing campaigns. Every day, your store grows bigger and more profitable!

title: The Zombie House
description:
Protect your home from endless waves of zombies!
Defeat zombies to collect coins and ability drops.
Use coins to upgrade both your player and your house.
Each level makes the zombies stronger.
How long can you survive?

title: Secrets of Charmland
description:
● Unique gameplay: help Emma treat her friends by swapping and matching delicious sweets!
● Tons of match-3 levels filled with exciting elements, awesome boosters and explosive combinations!
● A world full of Charmland: discover all the magical places it has to offer!
● Fantastic characters: watch Emma making new acquaintances and helping them with their unusual quests.

title: Drive To Survive
description:
Dive into the world of the zombie apocalypse, where your car is the only weapon!
Shoot down hordes of zombies, earn money and unlock new powerful cars.

Earn money - use your skills to become a master of survival!
Buy cars - from classics to supercars!
Explore new locations - each level is full of challenges!

Show the zombies who's boss!

title: Heritage Mahjong Classic
description: Immerse yourself in a timeless Mahjong experience with Heritage Mahjong Classic. Featuring a single elegant layout, three unique tile skins, a time bonus for quick matches, and a competitive leaderboard, this game offers a simple yet captivating challenge. Perfect for players of all levels, enjoy a relaxing atmosphere as you match tiles, earn bonuses, and climb the ranks. Are you ready to test your skills and embrace the charm of classic Mahjong? Start your journey today!

title: Crazy Bunnies
description: An exciting platformer about super bunnies in which you have to go through levels created in the style of Minecraft. There is a single and cooperative mode.

title: Yummy Tales 3
description: Join Oscar, the clever farm dog, in Yummy Tales 3 — the fun and addictive Match 3 puzzle game! Match 3 or more fruits and veggies to feed your farm animals and reach level goals before you run out of moves. Enjoy over 2500+ exciting levels, daily missions, and challenges. Collect daily gifts, boosters, and fantastic rewards to help you beat tricky puzzles. Harvest the fun and start playing Yummy Tales 3 now!

title: Slide Rabbit
description:
Swipe up, down, left, or right to move!
Don’t fall into holes or hit wolves or spikes, or it’s game over!
Avoid obstacles and eat as much food as you can!

title: Zombie Rush
description:
Zombies Rush is a fast-paced top-down survival shooter that pits a lone survivor against an endless, evolving horde. Built for fluid action, this 2D arcade shooter, turns every escape into a high-stakes dance with death.
Tilt and weave through trees to outmaneuver the rush.
Each wave brings faster, smarter, and deadlier undead threats.
Experience a modern take on the classic zombie survival genre with clean, stylized graphics and kinetic combat.

title: Fox Adventure
description:
Is a dynamic endless runner that brings back the spirit of classic arcade games!
Run or Lose! Control a brave fox in a world where danger lurks at every step. Fiery meteors rain down from the sky, and deadly spikes cover the ground. Your reflexes are your best weapon. Jump, dodge, and survive as long as you can!
Build Your Collection Grab gold coins along the way! Visit the shop to unlock unique looks: become a futuristic Cyber-Fox, put on a Clown costume, wear the Royal robe.

title: Sorting Balls
description: Sorting Balls is a fun and challenging puzzle game where players must sort colored balls into the correct tubes. The goal is to organize all the balls by color using logical thinking and strategic moves. As the levels progress, the puzzles become more complex, requiring careful planning. With simple controls and engaging mechanics, Sorting Balls is perfect for players who enjoy brain-teasing challenges.

title: Bubble Up
description:
Help BUB, a tiny bubble, fulfill its dream of reaching the blazing sun. Use his bubble friends, BLE, to push BUB past obstacles, rise from the ground to towering buildings, and conquer the skies!

You only need to shoot out BLE by click left mouse, good luck!

title: sprunki clicker & merge phase 3
description: Sprunki Clicker & Merge: Phase 3 is an exciting rhythm-based idle game where you tap to earn money and unlock new Sprunki creatures! Each Sprunki has a unique musical beat, and as you merge them, you create richer, more dynamic melodies. Grow your collection, upgrade your beats, and become the ultimate Sprunki maestro!

title: Smashdoll
description:
Smashdoll – Ragdoll Smash Game is a fast and chaotic physics game where you smash through floors, obstacles, and enemies to reach the bottom! Collect coins, dodge bullets, and upgrade your smash power, jump force, and trails.

Break enough floors to charge your smash meter and transform into an unstoppable bullet of destruction. How far can you smash?

title: Catch Thief
description: Catch Thief is an addictive puzzle game where you must outsmart a clever thief and stop his escape. Take control of the police, block every possible path and drive the criminal into a dead end. With each new level the challenge grows, requiring you to plan ahead, think strategically and act quickly. Bright cartoon graphics, fun scenarios and increasing difficulty make Catch Thief a perfect choice for fans of logic games who enjoy testing their skills, attention and reaction speed.

title: Water Sort
description: Experience the simple yet addictive water sorting puzzle game! It’s the ultimate free game for training your brain, killing time, and relaxing!

title: Sliding Gems
description:
Embark on an enchanting journey of matching gems! Dive into a realm filled with shimmering jewels, tactical maneuvers, and irresistible puzzle trials.

Slide and place vibrant gems to unveil newfound powers.

Confront challenges with diverse boosters to overcome obstacles and achieve higher scores.

title: Falling Blocks - Halloween Challenge
description: Step into the Halloween fun with Falling Blocks - Halloween Challenge, a thrilling match-3 arcade game! Match 3 or more spooky blocks, including pumpkins, ghosts, and skulls, as they rapidly fall from above. Your reflexes and strategy will be put to the test to clear the board and prevent a pile-up. Featuring vibrant Halloween visuals and addictive gameplay, this game provides hours of entertainment for all ages. Face the challenge, set high scores, and embrace the Halloween spirit!

title: Fishing the Russian Way
description:
Embark on a journey through Central Russia: picturesque rivers and lakes, different types of fish, and the exciting process of fishing. Improve your tackle, control your rod, decide the fate of your catch, and add to your collection of rare finds.

Use your car to discover new locations, complete tasks, participate in tournaments, and receive daily rewards. Freedom of choice and the path to becoming a true fishing master await you!

title: Battle Island 2
description:
Battle Island 2 is sequel of Battle Island
Battle with wild monster and trainers.
Earn money from battles and use it to build the army of powerful monsters.

You have only 1 goal, defeat all the Trainers and be the Master of Island.

title: Stickman Army: The Defenders
description: The green army is fighting the red army in an epic battle... Defend the White House at all costs and become victorious!
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Chicken Jump : A Tap Challenge
description: This is simple but addictive chicken jump game. You'll have lots of levels and you have to save your chicken but swiping on screen from bottom to up to make chicken jump so that it can avoid hurdles.

title: Arrow Escape: Puzzle
description:
“Arrow Escape: Puzzle” is a logic puzzle where arrows block each other, and your goal is to untangle routes and clear the level by choosing the correct move order.

- Short levels you can play in a minute.  
- Focus on logic and move order, not speed.  
- Simple controls: one tap — one move.

title: Highschool Mean Girls 3
description: High School Mean Girls 3 is a fun beauty dress-up game that combines high school drama with glamorous fashion! Step into the world of competitive style as you transform two rival friend groups into showstopping fashion icons.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Chicken Wars Merge Guns
description: The lands of the chickens are under attack. They are trying to defend themselves with their guns. Help them! It is a tower defense game in which you merge chickens and create more powerful chickens to defend your lands. The enemy will come over you wave by wave. Make sure they don't break your defense.

title: Circle Run Endless
description: Circle Challenge is an endless game, you need to keep the circle not touch the line. Collect the gifts and using it to buy the circle in the shop.

title: Car Paint
description: Carpaint is a free, family-friendly HTML5 logic puzzle game and casual brain teaser featuring 30 vibrant color grid challenges. Guide colorful cars across a 3×3 board, leaving paint trails to match reference patterns. This addictive, cross-platform online puzzle works in any browser or on mobile - play now!

title: Flag Puzzle Jam: Collect Flags
description: Immerse yourself in Flag Jam, a unique blend of puzzle-solving, flags collecting, and visual ASMR effects! Tap to match banner pieces, watch them glide smoothly into place, and clear the board as you complete each flag. With easy-to-learn mechanics and stunning visual effects, Flag Jam is the perfect game to help you unwind.

title: Hexagon
description: Embark on a merging frenzy with "Hexagon"! Place hexagonal tiles on the board, watch them merge and multiply. Create chain reactions and earn points as you strategically fill the hexagonal grid. Can you reach the ultimate merge and trigger the explosive power of 512? Play now and test your merging skills!

title: Cubes 2048.io
description: Begin an exciting .io battle where Snake meets 2048 in a nervous arcade showdown. Control your cube snake, collect, merge, and grow bigger while outsmarting opponents in this classic action-puzzle game. Control your snake to navigate around the map. Collect more cubes and merge the same numbers to reach 2048. Match the same number to make it bigger.

title: Escape or Die - Troll Devil Levels
description: Escape or Die: Troll Devil Levels, you’re thrust into a nightmarish world where trolls, twisted by ancient demonic curses, guard labyrinthine dungeons filled with deadly traps and unspeakable horrors. Your mission? Escape each level with devil alive— or end up as another soul devoured by the Troll Devil’s wrath. With ever-changing challenges and escalating danger, only the quickest, smartest, and bravest will survive.

title: Magnet Truck
description: What happens if you take a car with a huge magnet? It could pull metal right out of the ground and rocks! Upgrade and get more and more expensive metals!

title: Mystical Blade 3D
description: Enter the world of Mystical Blades, where you design and battle your own B-Blades! Mix blades, rings, and elements to create powerful combos, then face players worldwide in thrilling battles. With stunning graphics and realistic physics, prove your skills and become the ultimate B-Blades master!

title: Merge Sesame
description: This is a game anyone can easily learn and enjoy with the whole family!  With addictive sound effects and feedback, complete consecutive combos to relieve stress! If you hit a high combo with an object, your score will soar! There are no penalties or time limits, which means you can enjoy the game at your own pace. If you are looking for wonderful combination effects that are pleasing to the eye, join this game and challenge for the best score.

title: Moto Attack
description: Face the wonderful Moto Attack Showdown! In this explosive action game, you’re not just racing. You’re also shooting and fighting your way through waves of enemies in your powerful car! Perfect for every action-loving boy, Moto Attack is the high-octane combo of racing, driving, and shooting that you’ve been waiting for.

title: 3D FPS Target Shooting
description:
3D FPS Target Shooting is an addictive 3D FPS game. The logic of the game is very simple, use your weapon to aim and shoot various targets to get higher scores. Simple and unique gun control experience, aiming and shooting at the targets can be done easily with one hand.Kar98k, M24, and AWM are amazing weapons you can unlock them using the coins you get from passing the levels. The game is
completely free and you can play it online on any device!

title: Power Puzzle
description:
In Power Puzzle, you take control of a growing electrical network. Connect generators, route power through the grid, and bring every building to life — but every move matters.

? Gameplay
Connect power lines from generators to buildings
Manage limited connections and avoid inefficient routes
Every level is a handcrafted puzzle with increasing complexity
Multiple solutions are possible — can you find the most optimal one?

title: Word search
description:
A beautiful word puzzle game with challenging yet addictive features for hunting down the words you love! Train your brain in a fun and relaxing way and take your critical thinking skills and IQ to the next level.
Find all the words on a given topic. Words are arranged horizontally, vertically, diagonally, and may overlap.

title: Toy Assembly 3D
description:
Assemble a wide variety of brick buildings and scenes in this classic constructor game. Start as a baby builder and level your way up to increasingly complex construction sets. This relaxing and
satisfying game is sure to bring you back to the imagination and fun of your childhood!  Find the right piece and simply tap to add it to your build.  Get hands-on fun without the clutter or accidentally stepping on toys.

title: Wednesday Light Academia
description: Join the trend in Wednesday Light Academia - a fun, immersive makeover game for girls! Today you're becoming a super-talented stylist and your job is to transform Wednesday Addams from a dark e-girl look to a stunning girly-girl fashionista. Explore the fun realms of makeup, hairstyling, and fashion-forward wardrobe choices with this addictive game. Have fun!

title: Maze Craze
description: Step into the captivating world of Maze Craze, a puzzle game that combines creativity, humor, and strategic problem-solving. Perfect for puzzle enthusiasts and casual gamers, Maze Craze offers an endless journey through a variety of mazes, each with its own unique set of challenges and surprises.

title: Dop Puzzle Erase Master
description:
It is an interesting online game that will take you to an unparalleled puzzle-solving  experience. To solve the puzzles, you may use your imagination and ingenuity. You need to consider what do I erase to pass the level. Within the challenging levels, you  need to use strategic thinking to conquer each puzzle. In each level, you must make use of the
  eraser to erase a part of the picture to show a hidden object or scene. The deletion puzzles are  easy to learn, but challenging to master.

title: 8 Ball Pool Billiards Multiplayer
description: 8 Ball Pool Billiards Multiplayer is a competitive sports pool game that lets you test your skills in exhilarating 2-player matches against friends or go head-to-head with players from around the world. Perfect your game by competing against expert bots to sharpen your strategies and techniques.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Ragdoll Soccer 2 Players
description: Ragdoll Soccer: 2 Players is a sports soccer game that delivers the ultimate blend of soccer and chaos, where wobbly ragdoll physics takes over the field for hilarious and unpredictable gameplay! Step into the shoes (or, more accurately, the floppy limbs) of a stickman player and take on the challenge solo or face off against a friend in intense local multiplayer.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Red Hide Ball
description: In Red Hide Ball you protect designated balls from roaming monsters by manipulating the level layout and placing shields or obstacles. Each stage presents a fixed arrangement of elements and predictable monster movements, turning each solution into a small tactical exercise. Success depends on reading patterns, timing actions and using limited moves to create safe zones. The game balances accessible mechanics with steadily increasing difficulty to engage players who enjoy pure logic challenges.

title: Food Truck Chef™: A Fun Cooking Game
description: Food Truck Chef is a thrilling casual food game where you travel the globe, cooking iconic dishes from tacos to sushi. Manage your time, upgrade your kitchen, and serve customers to build your food truck empire.
genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Car Mechanic Simulator 2025
description:
In "Car Mechanic Simulator 2025", you are a master restorer who breathes new life into forgotten cars! 

Your task is to find old, broken, and abandoned cars, disassemble them down to the last screw, repair them, replace parts, and reassemble them, turning rusty piles of metal into shiny legends of the automotive industry. Search for rare spare parts, restore engines, choose the perfect paint, and bring every detail to perfection.

title: Stickman Troll Thief Puzzle
description: Thief Puzzle is a funny and addictive casual puzzle game. Here you should help a clever stickman with many funny ways to solve puzzles and steal target items. The rich and varied game scene contains many unexpected obstacles and traps, testing your intelligence and logical thinking. Each level of the game is a unique challenge. To make flexible movements of the character to overcome obstacles, avoid enemies, and successfully steal the target item.

title: Pin Puzzle Save The Sheep
description: Pin Puzzle: Save The Sheep is an exciting pin-pulling game. You will test your brain intelligence and have endless fun. In this game, you have to make the sheep eat food and save them from their predicament. You have many other tasks like pulling the pin to make the dog eat the food. But be aware that you may meet a lot of obstacles like bombs, lava, etc. and you need to avoid them. There are many interesting levels to play in this crazy puzzle game. Come and join the game.

title: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots
description: Break a Lucky Egg Brainrots is a fast and rewarding collection game where action, risk, and strategy come together. Your mission is to break brainrot eggs, collect rare Brainrot characters, and safely deliver them to your base before time runs out. Each run is a mix of decision making and reflex.

title: Puzzle Fever
description: A vibrant new puzzle game featuring colorful hexagons! This straightforward yet engaging game offers a plethora of hues. Simply drag the blocks to navigate, fill the gameboard, and accumulate coins and points! Puzzle Fever caters to players of all skill levels, providing unique levels across various difficulties, from Basic to Master.

title: Chrome Cars Garage
description: Dive into the world of car mechanics in this engaging hidden object game. After inheriting your grandpa's global network of garages, you take on the role of the new owner, with your Uncle Joe guiding you through the intricacies of the trade. Explore various locations, uncover hidden car parts, and learn the art of automotive repair.

title: Stickman Zombie vs Stickman Hero
description:
Stickman Zombie vs Stickman Hero is a stick war game about zombies, stickman, noob and pro who stole lucky block. The zombie boss is chasing them to bring the lucky block back to the roblox world, but the stickman hero escapes, resurrecting his allies along the way/

Game Features:
- You run away from the zombie boss and then play as him against the animator
- Various zombie, baldi and stickman animations
- The game is similar in style to minecraft, stick war, roblox and noob vs p

title: Match Tile Royal Family
description: Play an addictive brain challenge in Match Tile Royal Family. This is not just another match puzzle game. It’s a thrilling mix of logic, strategy, and quick thinking. Your goal is simple yet exciting: match tiles of the same design to clear the board. Unlock levels and rescue the royal family from tricky traps. Eliminate blocks, balls, and other objects in a limited number of moves. You can also use power-ups to quickly clear blocks or temporarily freeze obstacles.

title: 2 Player Mini Challenge
description: 2 Player Mini Challenge is an online casual game. If you want to play with your friends on the same device, or if you want to play alone against the AI, this is the game for you! This 2-player game collection features beautifully minimalist graphics that allow you to focus on going head-to-head with your opponent. The more participants you have, the more fun you'll have as you practice skills, react quickly, and interact with friends, relatives, and coworkers in a whole new way.

title: Fruit Survivor
description: Fruit Survivor is a cool and exciting 3D cartoon survival arcade game. You play as a gardener who is attacked by fruit monsters. You have to fight your way out and destroy them with different weapons. I recommend choosing the blender and maxing it out first. It can deal with many strong enemies effectively. You can also experiment with different weapon combinations to challenge yourself with harder levels. Enjoy hunting fruit monsters!

title: Idle Farm
description:
Run your own successful farm and build an empire! The more you grow and harvest, the more money you get!
Use the money to upgrade your fields and make harvesting even more effective at producing food. Keep an eye on your production - with careful planning you’ll achieve everything! Expand your farm further and further until you truly own an empire.
Hire farm managers to do most of the work for you. Use their help to expand your farming empire, plant new crops and produce even more food!

title: Cool Cars: racing at altitude
description:
Cool Cars: racing at altitude is an exciting racing game in which you can buy cars, build your own garage and compete with other players.

Earn points by collecting bonuses on a straight track, compete with other players to complete special tracks against the clock, equip your auto repair shop and collect cool cars!
In the game you will find a large number of cars, exciting tracks, your own garage with purchased cars, the ability to change the environment to suit you and much more.

title: CrazyZombies 3D
description:
Crazy Zombies 3D is a fast-paced top-down zombie survival shooter with cartoon-style 3D graphics. Use 10+ weapons to fight endless waves of zombies, conquer a town map, and unlock powerful upgrades. Battle 5 zombie types and 4 deadly bosses with unique abilities. Customize your loadout and survive as long as you can. Fun, intense, and addictive—can you survive the apocalypse?

?- Zombie Survival
?- 10+ Weapons to Master
?️- Conquer the Town
?- Boss Battles
?- Fun, Fast & Addictive

title: Traffic Tap Puzzle
description: Traffic Tap Puzzle is a challenging puzzle game where players must control traffic at intersections by tapping on cars to start or stop them. The goal is to avoid collisions while ensuring a smooth flow of vehicles. As the levels progress, traffic becomes more complex, requiring strategic timing and quick decision-making. With engaging mechanics and increasing difficulty, the game tests your reflexes and planning skills.

title: Mahjong Tile Club
description: Step into the relaxing world of Mahjong Tile Club, where timeless tile-matching meets innovative gameplay! This solitaire-style mahjong game is perfect for anyone looking for a calm yet engaging puzzle experience. With simple rules and soothing gameplay, it’s easy to pick up and hard to put down. Match identical tiles, clear the board, and enjoy a satisfying sense of accomplishment.

title: Peckshot
description: Stop the arrow at the right time and keep hitting the target. If you miss the target, the game ends. You can earn coins depending on the game results, and you can use the coins to get skins.

title: Mow It
description: Mow It Harvest is a colorful simulator in which you will have a farm and your own harvester at your disposal. You need to cut grass, sell colorful hay and move on to new levels. Cut grass like a real farmer and become a millionaire in this bright, exciting game!

title: Hair Salon: Beauty Salon
description:
Get ready to unleash your inner hairstylist with the adorable and entertaining game Hair Salon: Beauty Salon Spa! ?

This charming simulation game allows you to run your very own hair salon, where you can give your cute and quirky customers the hair style of their dreams.
From washing, styling hair and providing luxurious jewelry & makeup accessories, there's never a dull moment in this delightful game.

title: Mind Gambit
description: Mind Gambit is a relaxing puzzle game inspired by the classic Peg Solitaire. Plan your moves carefully to jump and remove pegs until only one remains. There’s no timer, just pure strategy and thoughtful gameplay. With unlimited levels, the challenge never ends.

title: Zombie Arena 2 Fury Road
description:
The player assumes the role of a driver in Zombie Arena 2 Fury Road, whose objective is to navigate a confined arena populated by zombies while using their vehicle as a weapon to overcome waves of the undead and unlock new levels.

Also, there are modes where you have to beat the clock or fend off waves of zombies, respectively, and games where you have to live as long as possible.

title: Crazy Bubble Breaker
description: Crazy Bubble Breaker is a fun and challenging 2D bubble shooter physics puzzle game. You have to destroy all bubbles with falling balls. You can aim the bubble with a subline and release the ball. You can also bounce the ball off the walls to hit more bubbles with one ball. Can you eliminate them? Dozens of levels are waiting for you to challenge! Use your brain and try to finish all levels with the fewest balls!

title: Merge Combo
description: Immerse yourself in this captivating merge puzzle game! Combine matching blocks to score points and trigger epic combos. The more blocks you merge, the bigger the numbers and combos grow! Test your strategy and aim for the highest score—how large a number can you create?

title: Walkers Attack
description: Walkers Attack is an action-adventure game. The end of the world is coming, make your way through a world full of danger and survive! Experience non-stop action with auto-fire and strategic movement. Gather resources, defeat hordes of zombies, and complete missions to unlock new themed levels ranging from sci-fi to medieval and urban. As the levels increase, so does the challenge. Are you ready to embark on a survival adventure? Can you be humanity's last hope? Good luck!

title: Two Stunt Racers
description: Skid the wheel of a stunning sports car through 3 awesome game modes and showcase your driving skills. Customize your car according to your taste and drive in style with the roaring engines. Feel the heat in 2 player mode where you go head to head with your friend in 2 amazing game modes! Are you ready to conquer the stunt city? Prove yourself with Two Stunt Racers!

title: Gun War Z1
description:
The world is in danger, a deadly virus affects more and more territories, turning people into zombies.

Clean up locations and save people

title: Cat Evolution 2
description:
Tap. Evolve. Dominate the Cat Kingdom!

The cats are back, and this time, they're taking over with the power of your fingertips! In Cat Evolution 2,  evolution goes clicker-style.
Tap your way through generations of quirky cats, unlock bizarre and adorable mutations, evolve to the max.

Get your paws ready and your fingers tapping. Cat Evolution 2 is the ultimate idle cat clicker you didn’t know you needed!

description:
Welcome to Grow a Garden, a fun and peaceful game where you plant seeds and grow magical trees! ?
Explore different seasons, customize your character, and watch your garden grow bigger every day.
Every seed is special and every garden is unique!

description: As a fearless pilot, your mission is simple: survive a relentless onslaught of rockets targeting your aircraft. Take the controls of a variety of planes and helicopters, each with unique skins to unlock and customize. Your goal is to navigate through perilous skies and bring your aircraft to the ground without crashing. But be warned: if you touch the ground, your aircraft will be exploded!

title: Jewel Solitaire TriPeaks
description: Rebuild glorious castles in a magical Solitaire adventure! Conquer 200 levels, master 12 variants – from Klondike to Spider – and enjoy fresh mechanics that reinvent the classic. The kingdom’s fate lies in your cards – are you ready to play your way to glory?

title: DriftClicker
description:
Race Clicker: DRIFT MAX is an action clicker that immerses you in the world of thrilling drift races, demanding lightning-fast reflexes and the ability to make decisions at high speed. Participate in dynamic drift where every turn is a high-speed challenge.
- Open containers to obtain unique parts and enhance your car.
- Participate in high-stakes races to earn keys for containers and unlock new possibilities.
- Upgrade your car to dominate races and defeat all your rivals.

description: Welcome to Two Dots Remastered, a fun and popular HTML5 connecting game enjoyed by gamers of all ages! Two Dot Remastered’s gameplay is straightforward: Match two or more dots in the same color (not diagonal ones) and then blast them! Enjoy playing Two Dots Remastered, the ultimate connecting game for gamers of all ages, and become a master at connecting dots!

title: Bffs Cherry Blossom Celebration
description: Step into the vibrant world of BFFs Cherry Blossom Celebration, the ultimate dress-up game where best friends come together to shine under blooming cherry trees! Pick your favorite crew of BFFs and deck them out in stunning spring outfits—think pastel dresses, floral crowns, and cherry blossom vibes.

title: Super Cloner 3D
description: In Super Cloner 3D, you are a unique super cloner on a mission to infiltrate dangerous environments. Use your cloning powers to escape traps, kill enemies, and accomplish secret missions.

genre: Basketball, Bike, Car, Casual, Controller, Browser Game

title: Conquer.io
description: Expand your zone and assert your dominance over every territory on the map. Plan your moves to outmaneuver opponents and gain as much space as possible. But beware, your rivals will stop at nothing to thwart your plans. Are you ready to claim your space?

title: Number Master Run And Merge
description: Number Master: Run And Merge is an awesome number racing game that lets you run, merge, and upgrade on a parkour platform to become a true number master! Control your number character as you run through dynamic tracks. Keep collecting more numbers and expanding. Merge with matching numbers to grow stronger. The bigger your number, the more unstoppable you become! Pick the smartest paths, hit speed zones, and keep your speed maxed out!

title: Celebrity Spring Manicure Design
description: Step into the glamour of ‘Celebrity Spring Manicure Design’! Explore a world of trendy nail art, vibrant colors, and chic designs. Join celebrities in setting the trend for spring nails. Elevate your style with creative manicures, from floral elegance to modern motifs. Immerse yourself in the art of nail fashion and transform your fingertips into a canvas of spring-inspired beauty.

title: Farm Mahjong 3D
description: Have you ever imagined playing your favorite 3D mahjong game in a farm setting? Mahjong 3D Farm does just that! It brings the popular Mahjong 3D game into the charming world of farms, filled with adorable animals, crops, and farming tools for you to match! So why wait? Play Mahjong 3D Farm Connect now and solve the puzzle amidst the fields!

title: Little Bugs
description: you are the guardian of a group of lost beetles. At each stage, the beetles approach two pictures. One is a safe path forward, but the other is a trapdoor into the abyss. Your mission is to decipher the hint—a piece of a vegetable or an animal—to figure out which path is safe. If you misunderstand the clue, you won't be able to reach the finish line. Every choice matters in this charming world of clever puzzles. Are you ready to lead your little bugs to safety?

title: Destruction of Stickman Zombie
description:
Take a weapon and destroy the zombie stickmen! "Destruction of Stick Zombie" is an exciting game in which you will fight against hordes of stickman zombies using your skills and strategies. You have to fight zombies to earn coins and improve your weapons.
You start the game as a regular player, but as you progress in the game, you become more experienced and skilled in combat. The more coins you earn, the more weapons and ammo you can buy.

title: Mystic Object Hunt
description: Welcome to 'Mystic Object Hunt,' a fifteen-level Hidden Object game. Explore ancient realms, discover hidden artifacts, and unravel secrets in dim chambers and ruins. Sharpen your skills, overcome challenges, and delve into the mysteries within each location. Get ready for a thrilling hunt!

title: King Kong Chaos
description: Embark on a thrilling adventure in King Kong Chaos, a modern 2D pixel art game where players must navigate through perilous levels, dodging spiked balls and barrels hurled by a colossal gorilla. Along the way, pick up the pickaxe strategically to destroy incoming barrels and secure the coveted golden banana to progress.

title: Royal Crown Blast
description:
Royal Crown Blast is a colorful and relaxing casual puzzle game where you tap, blast, and clear vibrant blocks to complete each level’s goals.
Immerse yourself in a royal atmosphere as you match groups of blocks of the same color and shape, triggering spectacular explosions and powerful boosters.
With many levels, charming visuals, and simple one-tap controls, the game is both relaxing and delightfully addictive.

title: Crowd Clash Rush
description: In this action-packed game, players will step into the shoes of a fearless warrior, ready to take on hordes of enemies. The game takes place in a vibrant and immersive 3D world, offering stunning visuals and realistic sound effects that will captivate players from the beginning.

title: Toka Boka Home Clean Up Design
description: A new family has just arrived in this town, and they're in desperate need of your assistance. This isn't just a helping hand mission; it's a home transformation and management simulator! You need to help them clean dust, clean the home, rearrange clothes, design the house, and repair damaged things.

title: Politon
description: Politon is a turn-based strategy game with easy-to-understand mechanics and satisfying visuals. If you want to test your strategical logic against enemies of different numbers and difficulty levels, Politon offers a variety of hex-based maps with various terrains. You'll need to manage your economy while expanding your territories and defend your region against rival invasions.

title: Dirty Them All
description: Let's splash some dirt over the walking people near the road with this Dirty Them All game! Drive your car through the mud and splash it all around the other people. Let them chase you until the finish line. The more people chase, the more scores you get. Let this funny and entertaining adventure begin!

title: ASMR Beauty Superstar
description: Welcome to ASMR Clinic, where relaxation meets rejuvenation! Our superstar guest is receiving expert care for acne-prone skin and rough feet in a serene atmosphere. Our skilled doctors will work their magic, providing personalized attention to detail and soothing care. Customize her look with various hairstyles, makeup looks, and shoes to create a stunning outfit that's uniquely hers. Unwind and express your creativity in this calming and fashionable game.

title: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion
description: Broomcraft Mystic Evasion is an action-packed horde survival game where you soar through the skies on a magical broom, battling waves of enemies! Defeat foes and gather experience points to level up and grow stronger. Unlock and master powerful spells, evolving them to take down enemies even faster. Good luck in your battles!

title: Granny's Classroom Nightmare
description: Step into the eerie halls of Granny's Classroom Nightmare, a horror survival game that blends the terrifying atmosphere of Granny Horror with the unsettling chill of an abandoned school. Trapped in an old, decaying classroom with Granny as your relentless pursuer, you must uncover hidden clues, solve twisted puzzles, and avoid her watchful gaze to escape. Each room holds a dark secret from a haunted past, and the slightest noise can summon Granny

title: Sweeper Curling
description:
Sweeper Curling is a fun and easy ice curling game for the whole family!
Slide your stones down the ice, aim for the target, and sweep to control
the speed. Play against a smart AI or challenge a friend in 2-player mode.
Simple controls and colorful graphics make it easy for everyone to enjoy!
